title: Big Dave's Fishing Adventures
specs: Fishing for Fall Chinook, Winter Steelhead, and Spring Chinook on multiple rivers and tidewaters
Steelhead average 8-13 lbs., Chinook average 15-30 lbs., occasional trophy fish up to 50 lbs.
Lodging accommodates up to 6 guests; can accommodate large corporate groups or family outings with prior notification

blurb: Big Dave's Fishing Adventures offers fully guided fishing trips for Steelhead and Salmon on the Oregon coast, including rivers and tidewaters near Tillamook. They provide all tackle and gear for fishing. Lodging is available at Wilson River Lodge with private river access and group accommodations.
extraNote: Summer Kings – July and August; Fall Chinook – mid-September to December; Winter Steelhead – December to mid-April; Spring Chinook – May and June
